Within the session, I focused on designing the actual PCB design on KiCad through the schematic editor. I focused on actually creating it, and that took me a while because I had to:
- get all the parts onto the board
- create the board
- organize them in a way where there won't be any errors when I run the ERC
I had to go through every single one of the buttons, label them, and put this thing on them. On the ones I didn't use, I'll put an X on them to cross them out, showing that there weren't going to be any connectors going to them, so that the electricity is in line.
After that, I connected all the routes together with the lines to make sure that whenever I do get the parts, they work well and in a way where every single one does what it's supposed to do.
